author: Siting Li, Zhengyang Wang, Simon Shaolei Du et al.

author: Maria Alejandra Gomez, Juan Manuel Castillo

title: ThinkPrior: Zero-Rollout Difficulty Priors for Cold-Start Prompt Selection in RLVR
summary: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trained with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), the KL-free reward-advantage term studied here depends on within-group reward variation. If all rollouts in a group are correct or all are wrong, their group-relative advantages are identically zero; these zero-advantage silent groups provide no reward-advantage gradient, yet uniform sampling spends 39% of a run's rollouts on them. History-based prompt selection must first spend target-policy rollouts to estimate difficulty, creating a cold start with rollout waste; ThinkPrior inste
author: Tommy Sha, Skylar Zhai, Siqi Zhao
